description: Global Electricity Markets Load Forecasting and Planning Dataset (GloElecLoad) is a data set described in the paper "Global Electricity Markets Load Forecasting and Planning Dataset (GloElecLoad)" in IEEE Data Descriptions (IEEE, 2026), produced by Sayed Mohsin Reza, Md Habib Ullah, Abdullah Al Ahad Khan and colleagues. This article introduces a dataset of electrical load profiles collected from electricity markets worldwide. The dataset is organized in folders by country and zone. It includes aggregated demand values with regional breakdowns and precise timestamp metadata. Coverage: electricity markets worldwide, organised by country and zone. The data are held on Mendeley Data, and the catalogue links the data set first and the paper second; nothing was downloaded, so the file formats and size are not checked. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Cost: free of charge according to the repository record; the paper's own access terms were not checked. Caveats: written from the paper's abstract and metadata only, so contents, quality and current availability are unchecked and the description may lag the source. It can support load forecasting and system planning. Related record: the journal-level record for IEEE Data Descriptions.
